protocol.name: treeland_compositor_state_unstable_v1
protocol.copyright: SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2024 - 2026 UnionTech Software Technology Co., Ltd. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
protocol.description:
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development. It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways, without incrementing the interface major version and without prior notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or semantics remaining stable across releases.
This protocol allows a privileged DDE client such as the dock to observe compositor state. It complements treeland_compositor_action_v1: that interface requests actions, whereas this protocol reports actual state independently of how it was changed, including keyboard shortcuts, gestures, and other clients. Sending an action request does not imply a state change.
The compositor must reject bind attempts from non-privileged clients. State reported to a client belongs to that client's desktop session.
The terms "must", "must not", "should", and "may" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

interface.name: treeland_compositor_state_manager_v1
interface.description: A global that creates compositor state subscriptions for privileged DDE clients.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this manager object. Existing state subscriptions are not affected.

request.name: get_state
request.description:
Create a state subscription. The compositor must send the current value of every state defined for the bound object version through the corresponding events when processing this request, and subsequently send an event whenever a value changes. No separate query is needed.
Each event is applied independently. There is no ordering guarantee between different state kinds and no event marking completion of an initial snapshot or update batch. Creating multiple subscriptions is allowed; each receives its own initial state and subsequent updates.

interface.name: treeland_compositor_state_v1
interface.description:
Observes current compositor state without changing it. The compositor must report actual state rather than echo action requests. Requests that leave state unchanged must not produce duplicate notifications after the initial state has been sent.
Each state has a separate event with its own arguments. Events may share parameter types and enums where their semantics match.
Clients may handle only the events they are interested in and ignore the others. Ignoring an event does not prevent the compositor from sending it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this object and stop observing state. This request does not change compositor state.

event.name: multitask_view_active

description.summary: whether the multitask view is active

event.description:
Sent when the subscription is created and whenever the multitask view activation state changes.
This describes logical activation rather than animation progress. An uncommitted gesture preview alone does not make the view active.

event.name: current_workspace
event.description:
Sent when the subscription is created and whenever the current workspace index changes. The index is the position of the current workspace in the session's workspace list, starting at 0; it is not a persistent workspace identifier.
The compositor must send an update if this index changes because workspaces are added, removed, or reordered, even if the current workspace retains its identity.

event.name: workspace_count
event.description: Sent when the subscription is created and whenever the number of workspaces in the session changes.

event.name: show_desktop
event.description: Sent when the subscription is created and whenever show-desktop mode changes. An empty workspace alone does not imply that show-desktop mode is active.
